summary: MTT-style individuation and copredication counting in Coq: common nouns as setoids (a Set plus an identity criterion packaged as an Equiv record); IC inheritance down the postulated subtyping chain Man<Human and Book<Phy.Info (coercions declared as axioms); the dot-type Phy.Info as a two-coercion record whose IC is the disjunction of the component ICs, proved reflexive and symmetric only (Equiv_K), reflecting the source's observation that the dot IC is not transitive; IC-relativized counting quantifiers (three_f, three_c with double distinctness, some, one); Sigma-record subsective adjectives (Heavybook, Heavyinfobook) with inherited ICs; the headline results MANWALK (three men walk -> three humans walk), copred_dd1/dd2 (John picked up and mastered three books -> he picked up three physical objects and mastered three informational objects), eight adjective+IC monotonicity theorems, and three->one. The War and Peace example appears only as Check smoke tests.

sources.citation: Chatzikyriakidis, S. & Luo, Z. (2018). Identity criteria of common nouns and dot-types for copredication. Oslo Studies in Language 10(2):121-141.
Luo, Z. (2012). Common nouns as types. LACL 2012, LNCS 7351:173-185.
Chatzikyriakidis, S. & Luo, Z. (2020). Formal Semantics in Modern Type Theories. Wiley/ISTE (chs. on CNs with ICs, coercive subtyping, dot-types).

evidence: copred_dd1/copred_dd2 prove the headline copredication-counting inference of C&L 2018 exactly as the disjunctive-IC/double-distinctness account predicts (ttr_mtt/Book_Individuation.v:133-145).

EQ-EQ7 verify IC inheritance along the full subtyping chain, and EQ1 proves exactly reflexivity+symmetry for the dot IC via the weakened Equiv_K record, mirroring the source's claim that the dot IC is not an equivalence relation.
MANWALK and threedf reproduce the source's counting-monotonicity worked examples.
All 20 theorems end in Qed with 0 Admitted; the only postulates beyond the signature are the three IC parameters (the theory's own primitives, rubric 3b) and two Set-valued coercion injections.
simplifications: dot-type Phy.Info encoded as a two-coercion record (the sources' own Coq move; genuine dot-types have no pairing constructor and require non-shared components — unenforced)
coercive subtyping replaced by axiomatized injections mh/bf + Coq Coercion
MTT universe cn rendered as Set
three_c hard-codes Book and ignores its CN argument (instance-level, not the source's generic determiner)
omissions: no theorem or countermodel establishing non-transitivity of the disjunctive dot IC (the motivation for Equiv_K is left implicit)
no generic determiner family beyond three/some/one; no negative predictions contrasting counting by BOOK1 (physical) vs BOOK2 (informational)
the War and Peace / on-the-shelf / worth-listening example is only Check-ed, never stated as a theorem
the source's linguistic account of how context selects the operative IC

HEAVYIBOOK2, a verbatim duplicate of HEAVYBOOK2

determination_rationale: A faithful formalization exists and the headline copredication-counting claims are fully proved with zero Admitted, but the core encodings are simplified rather than exact: Coq lacks coercive subtyping and dot-types, so both are simulated (axiomatized injections; a record with two coercion projections that wrongly admits pairing), and the cn universe collapses to Set. These are the sources' own published Coq workarounds and do not change the theory's predictions as exercised here; the three Equiv parameters are the theory's own IC axioms (rubric 3b). Artifacts are classes (ii) and (iv), consistent with determination 2.

artifact_classes.description: DomCN := Set identifies the MTT universe cn of common-noun interpretations with Coq's Set (type-value/universe collapse); records declared at sort DomCN

missing native structure: coercive subtyping simulated by Axiom injections mh/bf + Coercion, and the dot-type Phy.Info simulated by a record with two coercion projections, which supplies a pairing constructor and permits shared components that genuine dot-types exclude

notes: Record produced by the 2026-09-05 batch audit sweep; pre-atlas pilot file predating the zero-axiom discipline — 18 Parameter/Axiom lines (13 signature-constant lines, 2 Set-valued coercion injections, 3 IC postulates whose Equiv records bundle propositional equivalence proofs, counted as the 3 propositional axioms); no file header, primary 2018 OSLa source PDF not in papers/.
